    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    T = int(input[0])
    index = 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        X = int(input[index])
        Y = int(input[index + 1])
        index += 2
        if X == Y:
            results.append(0)
        elif (X - Y) % 2 == 0:
            results.append(2)
        else:
            results.append(1)
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))
